# NGAP: compliance register

What this is: the requirements of this area that are built and verified against running code, the typed rows recorded while building them, and coverage counts derived from the specs (verification.md §5). Requirements are in [`requirements.md`](../../requirements.md); deviations in [`deviations.md`](../deviations.md).

Specs read: TS 38.413 j40.

Row suffixes (requirements.md): -D defect in the sim, -B a choice the spec leaves open, -G declared gap, -V deviation from a "shall", -S spec contradiction and the reading chosen, -M mutant, -T T0 reading or measurement, -F a kaluza-core defect the sim found, -X retired. Verification: U unit, KAT or oracle test; F fuzz or property test; I interop; L lab; G gate row; A real-device comparison.

One session procedure at a time per UE, queued: a PDU SESSION RESOURCE SETUP REQUEST, or the sessions of an INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST after its first reconfiguration (the ICS response then carries them), gets one DRB per session, the session's default DRB with every flow on it (DRB IDs from 1, the lowest free); the CU-UP's bearer context by BEARER CONTEXT SETUP (K_UPenc and K_UPint from K_gNB, TS 33.501 A.8, for the AS algorithms in use; wiped once encoded) or by MODIFICATION to add; the DU's DRB by UE CONTEXT MODIFICATION with the CU-UP's F1-U uplink end; the DU's F1-U downlink end back to the CU-UP by MODIFICATION; then RRCReconfiguration with the DRB (SDAP header both ways, PDCP 18-bit SNs), the DU's cell group and the session's NAS PDU, and the response with the CU-UP's N3 end once the UE completes it. UP security: ciphering always (D1), integrity only when the session's policy says required, never for preferred (ADR 0009 point b). A PSI the UE already holds, or twice in one request, is answered as failed with multiple-PDU-session-ID-instances (F-26); no CU-UP, no E1 or no AS keys fails the request cleanly.
